d:
Di lallantop ka salana adda laut aaya hai. jamega 22, 23 aur 24 navanbar 2024 ko dilli ke mejar dhyan chand neshnal stediyam men. 3 dinon ke lie banie adde ka hissa sirph 499 rupae men. rajistreshan ke lie par die bainar par klik kijie
YT Description-The Lallantop’s Chunav Yatra reached the Barhait assembly seat in the Sahibganj district. Abhishek Tripathi talked to Gamaliel Hembrom, BJP candidate against CM Hemant Soren. Soren is also an MLA from this seat on the ticket of JMM.
